items.title: 2 killed, multiple injured after vehicle drives onto field during soccer game at Wichita sports complex
items.brief: Two people were killed and multiple others were injured when a vehicle drove onto a field during a soccer game at a sports complex in Wichita, Kansas, on Saturday, authorities said.

items.title: Man shot and killed on subway platform in midtown Manhattan after argument
items.brief: New York (AP) — An argument on a subway platform in midtown Manhattan turned deadly Saturday, leaving one man fatally shot and train service disrupted.

items.title: Half a million protesters sweep France in major show of youth unrest
items.brief: Clouds of tear gas fired by police filled the streets of Paris on Saturday, as anti-government protests stretched beyond the French capital.

items.title: Israeli settlers attack group of European diplomats in the occupied West Bank
items.brief: Israeli settlers attacked a group of European diplomats in the occupied West Bank on Saturday, one day after a Washington Post journalist was injured in another assault.

items.title: Washington Post journalist hospitalized after Israeli settler attack on Palestinian olive harvest in West Bank
items.brief: A Washington Post photojournalist was hospitalized after Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank attacked her and a group of Palestinians during the annual olive harvest.

items.title: Trump waives Russia-related sanctions before they even kick in as Ukraine ties worsen
items.brief: US President Donald Trump has waived a further slate of sanctions related to Russian fossil fuel sales, days before they were to take effect under a bill he signed into law last month.
